description: The twelve prompts that carried all 25 observed two-card divergences across the powered arms, reconstructed exactly as the concurrency harness expands them so each is byte-identical to the prompt that flipped. Filling a batch with these instead of the full suite concentrates the events: the whole-suite divergence rate is about 0.7% of requests while these sites run near 6%, so the same statistics arrive roughly an order of magnitude sooner. The harness re-expands whatever it is given, so these are the base prompts of the targeted suite and it will append its own case suffix on top - the sites are preserved as a family, not byte-for-byte.
metric: Measured aggregate completion tokens divided by synchronized HTTP batch wall time; output identity is checked against a sequential oracle for every expanded prompt.
